methods.gaps: 4-connected supported cells at/below height threshold, >=25 m²; roof patches plus 2 m excluded. Enclosed screening requires >=80% high-cell boundary, no missing/tile boundary and no roof contact. Geometry display simplified 0.75 m; area from original cells.
methods.plots: 25/50 m tile-origin squares. Height mean/median/P95/SD are surface-cell metrics over all finite heights including structures. Cover is share of supported surface cells >2 m, not return cover. Candidate density uses supported area, not stem counts. Support % denominator is a complete square; clipped squares remain partial.
methods.clearance: Exact horizontal distance from candidate roof polygon to nearest supported elevated cell centre within 30 m, excluding all roof patches plus 2 m. Cell-edge range is centre distance ±0.707 m. Candidate surface includes unclassified structures; this is proximity screening, not measured 3D vegetation clearance.
